title: Learners in initial VET by canton and training form (Switzerland)
description: Total stock of learners in Swiss initial VET by canton of the training company (Lehrbetriebskanton) and training form (dual vs full-time school-based). 'CH' is the national total.
source_label: Gesamtbestand der Lernenden nach Ausbildungsfeld, Lehrbetriebskanton, Ausbildungstyp, Ausbildungsform, Geschlecht und Jahr
comparability: Source: BFS survey 'Berufliche Grundbildung (inkl. Qualifikationsverfahren)' (SBG-SFPI), calendar-year reference period, based on apprenticeship-contract and qualification-procedure records. Cantons are those of the training company (cantonal boundaries as at 1.1.2022). National series: do not add to other countries' figures.
